limitations: Battery percentage is derived from measured voltage and the configured/default curve; it does not independently prove physical battery presence.
The 60-second sample limit is evaluated against the last recorded heartbeat, not wall-clock time after a hard hang.
Only known crash reset causes count; ESP32 brownouts are excluded.
MCU selection covers approved nRF52 REG1 circuits, not REG0, external PMICs or ESP32/RP2040 CPU rails.
Current integrated STM32WL targets keep their existing shared MCU/radio supply configuration; manual selection and automatic recovery are unsupported there.
RAM admission is a linked capacity model, not a physical heap/stack high-water measurement.
Native and emulated execution do not establish current consumption, battery-only cold starts, TX supply stability or physical recovery on other boards.
No regulator capability marker or firmware-picker control was added; supported controls are CLI and ESP32 WebConfig.

A private Full diagnostic with Reader omitted can qualify tested common regulator paths, but it is not the unmodified shipping Full image and does not establish shipping Full/BLE fault/load acceptance.
